output.summary: A slow-growing shrub or small tree thought to be native to the southeastern foothills of the Himalayas. Its large, fragrant fruit has a thick, coarse rind and usually dry pulp with little juice. The rind is commonly cooked in syrup or candied for sweets and cakes.
output.edibilityNote: The thick rind is cooked in syrup or candied; the fruit also supplies juice, drinks, preserves, pickles and seasonings.
